# Test: Retry update EVE from monolithic to split-rootfs OCI image
# Scenario: monolith -> failed split(v1) rollback -> retry same split(v1)
#
# This is used only for the split-rootfs full workflow after the Adam-loss
# rollback case. A plain eveimage-update of the same version is blocked by
# baseosmgr, which treats it as the same failed update still present on the
# other partition. The proper operation here is eveimage-update-retry.
#
# Env vars:
#   EVE_VERSION  - split-rootfs EVE version tag (required)
#   EVE_REGISTRY - OCI registry path (default: lfedge/eve)

{{$eve_ver := "0.0.0"}}
{{$eve_registry := "lfedge/eve"}}

{{$env := EdenGetEnv "EVE_VERSION"}}
{{if $env}}{{$eve_ver = $env}}{{end}}

{{$env_reg := EdenGetEnv "EVE_REGISTRY"}}
{{if $env_reg}}{{$eve_registry = $env_reg}}{{end}}

{{$eve_hv := "kvm"}}
{{$eve_arch := EdenConfig "eve.arch"}}
{{$short_version := printf "%s-%s-%s" $eve_ver $eve_hv $eve_arch}}
{{$test_info := "test eden.lim.test -test.v -timewait 30m -test.run TestInfo"}}

# ── Step 1: Verify monolithic base after rollback ────────────
message 'Monolith->Split-Retry: verifying monolithic base...'
eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'monolithic'

# ── Step 2: Retry the previously failed split update ─────────
eden controller edge-node update --config timer.test.baseimage.update=300

message 'Monolith->Split-Retry: retrying split image update...'
eden -t 10m controller edge-node eveimage-update-retry
! stderr .

# ── Step 3: Wait for activation on new partition ─────────────
message 'Monolith->Split-Retry: waiting for update to activate...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:active InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $short_version }}'
stdout '{{ $short_version }}'

# ── Step 4: Wait for Extension services (SSH) ────────────────
message 'Monolith->Split-Retry: waiting for Extension services (SSH)...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-ssh.sh

# ── Step 5: Verify split-rootfs state ────────────────────────
message 'Monolith->Split-Retry: waiting for extsloader ready state...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-extsloader.sh

message 'Monolith->Split-Retry: verifying Extension loaded after retry...'

eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo present || echo missing'
stdout 'present'

eden eve ssh 'ls /persist/ext-img*.img'
stdout 'ext-img'

eden eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo mounted || echo not-mounted'
stdout 'mounted'

eden eve ssh 'ls /dev/mapper/exts-verity-* 2>/dev/null && echo verity-active || echo no-verity'
stdout 'verity-active'

eden eve ssh 'count=$(ls /persist/ext-img*.img 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "ext-img-count:$count"'
stdout 'ext-img-count:1'

message 'Monolith->Split-Retry: SUCCESS - retry worked, Extension mounted via dm-verity'

-- wait-ssh.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do
    if timeout 10 $EDEN eve ssh echo ssh-ready 2>/dev/null; then
        exit 0
    fi
    sleep 5
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "SSH not available after 150s"
exit 1

-- wait-extsloader.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 24 ]; do
    MOUNTED=$($EDEN eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo yes || echo no' 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$MOUNTED" = "yes" ]; then
        echo "Extension mounted at /persist/exts"
        exit 0
    fi
    echo "Waiting for Extension mount (attempt $((i+1))/24)..."
    sleep 10
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "Extension not mounted after 240s"
exit 1
